t: This 3" Flat Paint Brush, part of the Fortress Trade range, offers efficient and precise application for painting and decorating tasks. Crafted with solid, round tapered synthetic filaments, it ensures superb paint load capability and excellent control, significantly reducing tramlines for a smooth finish. The comfortable beavertail handle provides ergonomic grip during extended use. This versatile brush is suitable for applying all types of paints and varnishes, making it an essential tool for professional decorators and keen DIYers tackling interior and exterior projects. Its design also facilitates quick and easy cleaning, maintaining brush longevity and performance.
